claims.statement: ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware is installed innermost so its deadline covers the provider call itself, and a resulting timeout is recorded and re-raised by ModelErrorMiddleware before escalating outward to ModelFallbackMiddleware, which treats TimeoutError as a retryable transient error.

The reviewer graph installs a leaner middleware chain with no model fallback, plan mode, PR guard, workflow push guard, subdir-agents read hook, dynamic tools, task retry, or run-usage hook; it uniquely adds RepairOrphanedToolCallsMiddleware and settle_review_check_on_exit, while also installing ModelErrorMiddleware.

check_message_queue_before_model reads the LangGraph store namespace (queue, thread_id), snapshots and injects pending messages FIFO before the next model call, then removes only that consumed snapshot so follow-ups appended while message construction awaits remain queued.

ModelFallbackMiddleware wraps the model call in a retry loop that alternates between the primary and a cross-provider fallback model on transient errors, using an exponential backoff schedule with jitter, retrying on 5xx/429-class statuses, connection/timeout errors, and the TimeoutError from ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware.

When every ModelFallbackMiddleware attempt fails it returns a terminal AIMessage describing the outage instead of raising by default, and provider model-not-available errors short-circuit into a user-facing AIMessage.

ToolErrorMiddleware converts ordinary unhandled tool exceptions into status=error ToolMessages, but treats an unreachable sandbox as terminal: it notifies the user and re-raises the error to end the run.

ToolErrorMiddleware converts SandboxRetryableConnectionError into a sandbox_transient error ToolMessage because the SDK guarantees the command never started; SandboxConnectionError except SandboxServerReloadError, and ResourceNotFoundError for the sandbox resource, are unreachable and are notified then re-raised.

The agent installs ToolRetryMiddleware scoped to the task tool with task_retry_on retrying on 5xx/429-class statuses and transient exception names (including a subagent's ModelCallTimeoutError since subagents lack fallback middleware), while task_on_failure returns a structured failed payload for prompt/context errors and re-raises otherwise.

retry_transient_sandbox_errors retries only SDK-marked SandboxRetryableConnectionError failures before a command starts, with at most four attempts and jittered bounded exponential backoff; terminal sandbox errors are not retried.

Sandbox-unreachable notification targets an active Slack thread first, then Linear, then a configured GitHub issue or pull request when a token is available; the coding-agent message avoids automatic replacement because it could discard uncommitted work.
Reviewer sandbox setup permits replacement because its checkout is re-derived, whereas the default coding-agent sandbox setup does not; a failed replacement remains a typed SandboxUnreachableError.

The guard and utility layers repair malformed tool inputs, enforce PR and workflow-push policy, refresh the GitHub proxy, inject wrap-up and step-limit notices, persist successful-run usage, and repair reviewer orphaned tool calls.

BasePrepareRunMiddleware fingerprints the latest message, middleware class, and preparation configuration; its checkpointed run_prepared_for latch skips setup for a resumed matching invocation, while preparation can execute again after a pre-checkpoint failure and must be idempotent.

ModelErrorMiddleware logs and classifies model-call exceptions, records the error type and classification code in thread metadata when context is available, and re-raises the original exception unchanged.

RecordRunUsageMiddleware tags model responses with route and invocation metadata, finalizes configured invocation usage after the agent completes, and finalizes it with error status when its model-call wrapper catches an exception.

settle_review_check_on_exit closes an unpublished tracked reviewer check as neutral so an incomplete review is not presented as a PR code failure, but retries a stored pending real conclusion when publish_review completed and only its completion PATCH failed.

The coding-agent middleware is assembled outer to inner as ConversationOffloadingMiddleware, PrepareAgentRunMiddleware, TranscriptMiddleware, conditional incident/workspace-skills/dynamic-tools layers, input and image validation, model-call limit, tool error handling, tool filtering and subdirectory instructions, task retry, PR/workflow guards, proxy refresh, conditional queue pickup, wrap-up/reply/step-limit/usage hooks, conditional model selection and fallback, provider sanitizers, stable tool-result ordering, ModelErrorMiddleware, and innermost ModelCallTimeoutMiddleware.

TranscriptMiddleware treats transcript persistence as best-effort observability: it keeps per-run state in a registry, queues events to one background writer per run, and logs and swallows transcript failures so they cannot fail an agent run.

RequireUserReplyMiddleware resets reply-surface and retry state at run start, retries a turn that owes a user-facing reply but lacks a successful reply-tool result with at most two nudges, and posts the last assistant text on the model's behalf after that budget.

ModelSelectionMiddleware selects and stores a fast, balanced, or performance route before a turn, uses a hidden structured-output classifier in automatic mode with balanced fallback on classifier failure, and overrides the request model for the selected route.

ValidateImageReadsMiddleware checks image blocks returned by read_file against image magic bytes and replaces a mismatched attachment with a text error ToolMessage, preventing invalid image content from reaching a provider on later turns.

RepairOrphanedToolCallsMiddleware inserts a synthetic error ToolMessage directly after each persisted AI tool call without a matching result before a reviewer model call, making interrupted tool use recoverable instead of provider-invalid.
